description_en: Queries the binding information of a landline AXN extension number
description_zh: 查询已绑定固话AXN分机号信息
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi query-axn-extension-bind-fixed-line --app-id FC100000168480000 --ts 20161114143116123 --query-type 0 --sub-id A20300000000000000 --tela 15500001111 --order-id 1230000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryAxnExtensionBindFixedLine

parameters.help_en: The ID of the number pool
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The business timestamp. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format, accurate to milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 业务时间戳，格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒
parameters.name: ts

parameters.help_en:
The query type. Valid values:

- 0: query by binding ID.

- 1: query by X and A/B numbers
parameters.help_zh:
查询类型。取值：

- 0：根据绑定ID查询。

- 1：根据X和A/B号码查询
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en: The binding ID. This parameter is required when QueryType is set to 0
parameters.name: sub_id

parameters.help_en: The number A. This parameter is required when QueryType is set to 1
parameters.name: tela

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the message request
parameters.name: order_id
